title: Rabbi Simon of the South
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: He is mentioned in Esther Rabbah 4:4. Hyman suggests that perhaps he is the Rabbi Simon without further designation, who was also from the South, with ריב״ל.[^1]

notes.text: The whole Torat Emet Esther Rabbah 4:4 paragraph explicitly names Rabbi Simon min Daroma, supporting the local full title. Hyman’s perhaps-identification with the unspecified Simon remains tentative. The separate ריב״ל pointer was not independently collated here and stays unexpanded; the earlier expanded title remains in immutable history.
